这条路线适合连续三天住在旧金山、每天愿意走一段路的人。把第一天留给东北侧街区，第: This plan works best with three nights based in San Francisco and some walking each day. Explore the northeast neighborhoods first, the Presidio and bay second, and eastern Golden Gate Park third. Allow one seated meal and one optional addition each day. If arrival leaves only half a day, use the shortened first day and move the rest back.
出发前：只锁定一项最想去的付费体验: Before you arrive: book the one paid experience you care about most
先决定恶魔岛、科学馆和 Exploratorium 中哪一项最重要，再按余票安排: Choose your priority among Alcatraz, the Academy, and the Exploratorium before fixing the order. Follow the NPS link to Alcatraz City Cruises and confirm that the ticket includes landing; a sightseeing cruise around the island is a different product. Allow half a day for check-in, boats, and the island, replacing most of day one. Avoid booking all three and squeezing neighborhoods into the gaps.
第一天：海湾入口 → 唐人街 → North Beach: Day one: waterfront arrival → Chinatown → North Beach
编辑安排约 10:00–17:00；完整步行约 4–6 公里，按酒店位置和绕行变: Editorial plan: roughly 10 am–5 pm, with about 4–6 km of walking depending on your hotel and detours.
上午：Ferry Building 与 Embarcadero: Morning: Ferry Building and the Embarcadero
从 Embarcadero 站出发，在 Ferry Building 周边吃早午: Start at Embarcadero station, eat around the Ferry Building, and enjoy the waterfront. Locate your return entrance and a restroom before a short walk. The farmers market does not run every day; the building and waterfront still make a good introduction.
中午：唐人街，慢看一两条街: Midday: a few streets in Chinatown
从市中心方向进入 Grant Avenue 一带，沿途择一处午饭或点心。街区有坡: Approach the Grant Avenue area from downtown and choose one lunch or snack stop. Expect hills; skip long stairways and use transit when needed. Keep heavily queued shops optional and leave time for signs, markets, and side streets.
下午：North Beach 与 Washington Square: Afternoon: North Beach and Washington Square
沿 Columbus Avenue 一带进入 North Beach，坐下喝咖啡: Continue around Columbus Avenue into North Beach for a coffee and a rest near Washington Square. Add the waterfront only if energy allows. The climb to Coit Tower is a separate activity; with a stroller or older relatives, staying near the square is a complete afternoon.
第一天只有半天，或选了恶魔岛: If day one is short, or you booked Alcatraz
半天版只选 Ferry Building 海滨或唐人街＋North Beach，: For a 2–3 hour version, choose either the Ferry Building waterfront or Chinatown plus North Beach. With Alcatraz, plan a meal near Pier 33 and a short waterfront walk after returning; leave the Golden Gate Bridge for another day. NPS confirms Mandarin audio, but check slopes, ferry times, and accessibility separately.
第二天：Presidio 看桥，给海风和休息留位置: Day two: bridge views from the Presidio, with time to rest
上午先到 Presidio Transit Center／Visitor Cen: Start at the Presidio Transit Center and Visitor Center, then explore Tunnel Tops. This is easier to shorten than beginning with a full bridge crossing. Check the Presidio GO Downtown Route or Muni from your accommodation. Some free shuttle trips during weekday commute periods restrict access, so read the markers on the actual departure you plan to use.
午饭后沿允许通行的道路下到 Crissy Field 看海湾，再折返或乘车离开。: After lunch, follow open paths down to Crissy Field, then return or take transit out. Allow about 3–4 hours and 2–4 km for the basic visit. Add one bridge viewpoint if you wish and check its transit connection; Tunnel Tops is not right beside the bridge entrance. A bridge walk, Fort Point, and the Palace of Fine Arts each need extra time, so choose at most one.
第三天：金门公园东侧，公园与博物馆二选一为主: Day three: eastern Golden Gate Park, with one main activity
把目的地设为 Music Concourse 附近，而不是地图上笼统的“Gold: Navigate to the Music Concourse area rather than the generic Golden Gate Park pin. For a free outdoor day, walk JFK Promenade and nearby lawns. For a museum day, give the California Academy of Sciences half a day and keep the outdoor walk short. The park stretches a long way east to west; Ocean Beach, the windmills, and the eastern Conservatory do not fit into one relaxed morning.
科学馆建议提前买票；天文馆另需预约场次，官方明确不接待 4 岁以下儿童，并提醒内: Buy Academy tickets ahead when possible. Planetarium shows require a reservation, do not admit children under four, and may not suit those under seven. With younger children, focus on the aquarium and natural history areas. On major event days, read both park and museum access alerts before deciding how to enter and leave.
下雨、大风或看不到桥：交换整天，比来回折返轻松: Rain, wind, or a hidden bridge: swap whole days
Presidio 当天风雨明显：与金门公园的室内馆日互换；如果尚未买票，再查当天: If Presidio weather is poor, swap it with the indoor museum day. If tickets are unbooked, check same-day availability. Read change and refund rules before buying competing reservations.
人在东北海滨遇雨：可把 Exploratorium 设为半天替代。官网常规周一关: If rain catches you on the northeast waterfront, consider half a day at the Exploratorium. Its standard schedule closes Mondays and starts general Sunday admission at noon; check exceptions. Thursday After Dark is for ages 18 and over.
只有薄雾且步行舒适：缩短海湾路线，留在 Tunnel Tops 或街区；不要为等: If it is only foggy and comfortable to walk, shorten the bay route and enjoy Tunnel Tops or a neighborhood. Avoid spending the whole afternoon waiting for the bridge to appear. Follow official weather and closure instructions.
三天交通：先数乘车次数，再决定通票: Three days of transit: count rides before buying passes
Muni 是市内公交、轻轨和历史电车；BART 的机场与跨湾段另算。2026 年: Muni covers city buses, light rail, and historic streetcars; BART airport and cross-bay trips are separate. Since September 2026, MuniMobile no longer sells new single rides, but day passes, cable car tickets, and Visitor Passports remain. Muni-only Day Passes exclude cable cars; Visitor Passports include them but exclude BART. Treat a cable car ride as an optional experience rather than routing your whole trip around a pass.
预算与体力：分开看必需支出和可删项目: Budget and energy: separate essentials from optional additions
编辑估算：以简餐、公共交通和免费户外点为主，每位成人可先预留每天 45–80 美: Editorial estimate: for simple meals, transit, and free outdoor stops, set aside roughly $45–80 per adult per day for food and transport. This excludes lodging, airport transfers, museums or Alcatraz, shopping, and expensive dinners, and is not a current vendor quote. Add the final museum checkout total separately and review restaurant taxes, tips, and service fees. Agree on shared essentials and allow independent time if budgets differ.
每人带挡风层、舒适鞋、饮水与充电设备；外套可随街区和海边温差增减。: Bring a windproof layer, comfortable shoes, water, and charging equipment; adjust layers between neighborhoods and the waterfront.
每天存好一个可提前结束的返程站点；步行困难者另查电梯状态与公园无障碍路径。: Save an early-exit transit stop each day; check elevator status and usable park paths when mobility is a concern.
长辈、推车或刚下长途飞机：把标出的步行量减半，只保留每天一项主活动。: With older relatives, a stroller, or jet lag, halve the walking target and keep one main activity each day.
预订页面、场馆关闭提醒、回程方向先截图；离开酒店时带走当天需要的证件与票，不在路: Save ticket pages, closure notices, and return directions before leaving. Carry the documents and tickets needed that day and organize luggage before going out.

Rail is a useful option if your accommodation is near BART, you can manage the bags, and all connections are operating. Include walking, Muni, or another ride after the station. If the hotel is uphill, far from rail, or requires transfers with two large suitcases, compare a direct car trip.

Do not assume every departure reaches Millbrae without a transfer. San Francisco's Caltrain station is not at Union Square or the Ferry Building. If one delay would lose the last connection, a direct option may be more practical on arrival night.
SFO 上车区：国内、国际、出租车和私人接机分开看: SFO pickup: distinguish terminal and vehicle type
SFO 总交通页列出的国内航站楼 Lyft／Uber 常用上车区是 Domest: SFO's overview lists Domestic Garage Level 5 for standard domestic-terminal Lyft and Uber pickups. Recheck the airport's dedicated instructions and the app for international terminals and other service types. Request a ride once all bags are with you and you can reach the pickup point, then match the plate to the booking. Friends should wait in an authorized area until you are ready, rather than waiting at the terminal curb.
OAK → 东湾或旧金山：先坐连接线，再换主线: OAK → the East Bay or San Francisco: connector first, main line second
按机场 BART 标志到连接线，先到 Coliseum，再乘主线前往目的地。官方: Follow BART signs to the airport connector, travel to Coliseum, and transfer to a main-line train. BART's airport page says arriving travelers pay on reaching the connector platform at Coliseum. Enter OAK Airport in the planner rather than Coliseum, or the airport leg will be omitted. Follow the planner and platform displays for that evening instead of memorizing line colors.
OAK 去半岛中南段或南湾时，地图看着隔海不远，铁路却可能需要多段衔接。以最终门: OAK can look close to the Peninsula or South Bay across the water, but rail journeys may involve several legs. Compare BART plus onward transit with a direct car trip to the final address. For groups, divide the car cost by passengers only after confirming luggage capacity. Ferries are not curbside airport connections; getting to the terminal and catching the last boat require separate planning.

去 Santa Clara Transit Center 换 Caltrain：: For Caltrain at Santa Clara Transit Center, check Route 60 toward Winchester. Santa Clara and San Jose Diridon are different stations; send the correct name to anyone meeting you.
去 Milpitas BART：查 Route 60 的 Milpitas 方向: For Milpitas BART, check Route 60 toward Milpitas, then follow the BART itinerary. There is no BART platform inside the SJC terminals.
去轻轨沿线：60 路可接 Metro/Airport Station；继续搭乘的: For light rail, Route 60 connects to Metro/Airport Station; onward light rail needs its own fare. SJC confirms free Route 60 boarding in either direction from the airport, not free onward rail.
十月仍需注意：SJC Terminal A 临时站移位: October arrival detail: SJC Terminal A's temporary stop
VTA 当前施工公告写明，原 Terminal A 站的临时替代站向北约 100: VTA's current construction notice places the temporary Terminal A stop about 1,000 feet north of the regular stop, near Delta ticket counters, effective March 24, 2026. The airport's general page still lists its usual stop number. Open Route 60 service alerts and follow temporary signs rather than relying on an old screenshot. Include this extra walk when assessing luggage or mobility needs.
晚到与延误：判断整条连接链是否还成立: Late arrivals: check whether the entire connection still works
每个换乘点都要查“最晚还能走通”的班次，而不是只看机场首段。BART 通常到午夜: Check the last viable connection at every interchange, not only the first airport departure. BART generally ends around midnight, but the last usable connection to a particular destination can be earlier. Use a dated itinerary. The 511 All Nighter network may offer buses with longer journeys and waits. If connections no longer work, stay in a clearly designated waiting or service area while arranging a taxi, rideshare, confirmed hotel shuttle, or nearby lodging.
比较费用：同一张表填三种完整方案: Compare costs on the same door-to-door basis
公共交通写全人数 × 各段票价，再加最后一程；汽车写订单总价、机场附加项、过桥费: For transit, total all fares for every passenger and add the final leg. For cars, record the quoted total and whether airport charges, tolls, waiting, or child seats are included. For hotel shuttles, confirm guest eligibility, final departure, and booking requirements. Rideshare prices vary by date, vehicle, and demand, so no fixed quote is offered here. Weigh any savings against luggage, fatigue, group size, and the check-in deadline.

电话先做实测：能拨出和接听、能收短信、离开 Wi-Fi 后能导航。购买长期套餐前: Test outgoing and incoming calls, texts, and navigation away from Wi-Fi. Before choosing a long-term phone plan, confirm device compatibility, effects of number transfer on existing verification texts, the post-promotion price, and cancellation terms. A temporary data plan may not include local calls or texts. Save home, work or school, and a basic shopping stop, then test the route and your transit payment in daylight.
需要新银行账户时，先向选定机构索取与你情况相符的开户材料清单，再约时间；不要把他: If you need a bank account, request the institution's document list for your situation before booking. Another person's documents are not a universal rule. Keep a working backup payment method and distinguish debit spending, credit card bills, and account charges. The milestone is being able to contact people and make essential payments; a long-term plan can follow later.
第 2–3 天：先定账单责任，再安排水电网: Days two–three: assign bill responsibility before opening utilities
逐项写下电、燃气、水、垃圾和网络由谁开户、谁付款、何日起算。合租可能由室友持账户: Record who holds and pays each electricity, gas, water, waste, and internet account, and from which date. A roommate may hold an account or a building may bill centrally; working lights do not mean the account is in your name. Use PG&E's start/stop/transfer service only where appropriate. Keep confirmation numbers, start dates, and access requirements, and track old-account closure separately.
网络先用完整单元号询问能否安装、最早可约日期、设备与安装费用，以及物业是否要开放: For internet, use the exact unit number to confirm installation availability, the earliest appointment, equipment and installation costs, and any building access needed. Test a temporary connection before committing to remote work or classes. A neighbor using a provider does not guarantee service to your unit. Close the task only after checking the first bill.
第 3–4 天：建立一个可复用的资料夹: Days three–four: build a reusable document folder
住处记录：签署的租约、入住交接、完整邮寄地址与单元号；保留可打印版本。: Housing records: signed agreement, handover, full mailing address and unit, with printable copies.
账户记录：本人姓名的开户确认、账单、预约确认和客服给出的补件说明。: Account records: confirmations and bills in your name, appointment details, and written document requests.
姓名与地址：检查拼写、连字符、姓与名顺序和单元号是否一致；不自行修改官方文件来制: Names and addresses: check spelling, hyphens, name order, and unit numbers. Do not alter official documents to make them match.
保管方式：个人加密存储或安全文件夹，原件单独收好；公开求助只描述文件类型，不发号: Storage: use protected personal storage, keep originals separately, and describe document types in public questions without posting numbers or full identity documents.
第 4–7 天：按用途预约，先问材料能否被接受: Days four–seven: choose the right appointment and confirm documents
驾照、普通 ID、REAL ID、已有证件改地址是不同业务。先写清自己需要什么，: A driver license, standard ID, REAL ID, and address update are different transactions. Define your purpose before opening the appropriate DMV process. REAL ID has its own requirements for two acceptable printed California address documents, identity, and name continuity; those rules are not universal across DMV services. Ask about acceptable alternatives before visiting if you are in temporary housing or the documents have different names.
学校或工作相关事项单独开一页：联系人、必须完成的步骤、机构给出的截止日与缺少的材: Keep a separate school or work page listing contacts, required steps, stated deadlines, and missing documents. Have the relevant institution or a qualified professional confirm identity, work authorization, or other eligibility questions. Days since arrival are not a universal legal timetable. Any actual deadline you receive takes priority over this editorial order.
第一周内：把公共资源和求助入口存进通讯录: During week one: save public resources and help contacts
先选离家或通勤路上最近的图书馆，核对开放时间和办卡材料。SFPL 明确向加州居民: Choose a library near home or your commute and check its hours and card documents. SFPL offers free cards to California residents, with in-person verification after an online application. Visitors or people missing documents should ask what access is available rather than assuming full borrowing or museum-pass privileges. On your first visit, check card eligibility, computers and printing rules, and one relevant language or learning program.
旧金山市政问题可联系 311；人在市外可拨 415-701-2311，官方提供全: For San Francisco city matters, use 311, or 415-701-2311 from outside the city; multilingual help is available around the clock. For food, shelter, employment, or family-support referrals, try 211. The 211 Bay Area page lists SF, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Marin, Napa, and Solano as its direct-service counties; East Bay residents should use the relevant county service. State your ZIP code, need, and language. A referral is not benefit approval.
第 8–14 天：更新收信地址，复核日常服务: Days eight–fourteen: update mail and check everyday services
有美国旧地址邮件需要转寄时，从 USPS 官方入口选择合适的临时或永久变更并完成: If you need mail forwarded from a previous U.S. address, use USPS's official process for the appropriate temporary or permanent change and identity check. Forwarding takes time and does not update banks, insurers, schools, employers, or government records; update those separately and save confirmations. A newcomer from abroad without a previous U.S. address need not create a forwarding request just to tick a box.
把日常照护也落实成联系人：向自己的保险计划、学校或雇主确认生效日期、服务网络、会: Turn everyday care arrangements into actual contacts: ask your plan, school, or employer about coverage start dates, the service network, member contact details, and pharmacy procedures. A card alone does not establish that every service is active. For children, older relatives, or regular care duties, align pickup and care times with your tested commute.
第 15–30 天：用账单和实际通勤调整生活: Days fifteen–thirty: adjust using real bills and commute experience
汇总一轮真实支出：房租、账单、食品、交通、临时住宿和一次性购置分开。押金是占用现: Separate real spending into rent, bills, food, transport, temporary lodging, and one-time purchases. A deposit ties up cash and its return depends on the agreement; do not count it as an ordinary monthly expense. Include extra commute time and car trips when comparing homes. If your long-term lease is still undecided, use actual experience to refine the area shortlist.
最后做一次家庭联络演练：能说出完整地址，知道楼内报修与紧急联络方法，并与同行者约: Finish with a household contact rehearsal: know the full address, building maintenance and emergency contacts, and a meeting point if separated. ReadySF's worksheet helps record home and work meeting places plus an out-of-area contact; residents of other counties should find their local alert service. Make the plan understandable to everyone and available offline or on paper.

从 SF 311 找到负责这件事的部门: Find the responsible SF department through 311
带上城市、问题类型和已有记录询问；可主动说明希望使用中文。: Ask with your city, issue, and existing records ready; request Chinese assistance if needed.
选住处前先跑一次：湾区跨湾通勤与生活半径实测指南: Test before choosing a home: cross-bay commuting and everyday access
把办公室门口、回家最后一程和周末生活放在同一张表: Compare the office door, the final trip home, and weekend life together
用六类真实目的地拆解 BART、Caltrain、渡轮和跨湾巴士的适用条件，再做: Use six destination patterns to compare BART, Caltrain, ferries, and transbay buses, then test two commutes and an everyday neighborhood walk. Includes a worked rent-versus-transport example.

需要兼顾家庭接送的人: People balancing commuting and family pickups
交通网络与官方规划入口核验于 2026-10-02。居住匹配、测试方法和成本例子: Transit networks and official planning links checked October 2, 2026. Housing fit, testing methods, and cost examples are editorial analysis. This is not a citywide safety or rent ranking and promises no door-to-door journey time. Recheck for your exact addresses, workdays, and return times.
BART：当前系统图与站点: BART: current system map and stations
区分正在运营的车站与未来扩建，不把 Berryessa 当作 Diridon。: Distinguish operating stations from future extensions; Berryessa is not Diridon.
用工作日、周末与晚归时间分别查完整行程。: Check separate itineraries for workdays, weekends, and late returns.
同一站不同车次停站不同，需同时核对回程。: Different trains serve different stops; check the return trip too.
跨湾线路、Salesforce Transit Center 与工作日／周末服务: Transbay routes, Salesforce Transit Center, and weekday/weekend service differences.
SF Bay Ferry：线路与时刻表: SF Bay Ferry: routes and schedules
区分 Oakland／Alameda、Richmond 等日常线路与工作日限定线: Distinguish daily routes such as Oakland/Alameda and Richmond from weekday-only services.
Golden Gate Ferry：北湾渡轮: Golden Gate Ferry: North Bay schedules
Larkspur、Sausalito 和 Tiburon 往返旧金山的线路与节假: Larkspur, Sausalito, and Tiburon links to San Francisco, including holiday information.
确认轻轨与巴士最后一程，不把城市名当成站点范围。: Check final bus and light rail legs rather than treating an entire city as a station's catchment.
为晚归测试寻找可用的夜间替代路线。: Find possible alternatives for a late-night return test.
先把公司、学校或每天必须到达的地方固定到建筑入口，再选区域。比如同样写“旧金山上: Pin the actual entrance to work, school, or your daily destination before choosing an area. A job near Embarcadero, in Mission Bay, or in western San Francisco can imply different housing choices. Keep three candidate addresses, each with a main route and a late-return alternative; this makes trade-offs easier to see than a long list of listings.
先认骨架：五个区域不是五种统一生活体验: Start with the network: five regions do not mean five uniform lifestyles
旧金山市内主要比较 Muni 与步行；半岛及部分南湾行程可查 Caltrain；: Within San Francisco, compare Muni and walking. Caltrain is useful for many Peninsula and South Bay trips. From the East Bay to downtown San Francisco, compare BART, transbay buses, and ferries where terminals fit. In the North Bay, include ferry, bus, or driving access. A ten-minute station walk and an additional bus transfer create different routines, even in the same city.
目的地一：旧金山东北侧、市中心与海滨办公区: Destination one: downtown and northeastern San Francisco
办公室靠 Embarcadero 或 Montgomery 时，先比较步行可达的: Near Embarcadero or Montgomery, compare the final walk from BART, the Ferry Building, and Salesforce Transit Center. Some East Bay addresses are closer to a transbay bus stop than BART, so check both. Transbay routes differ in all-day, weekend, and peak service. Test Saturday early shifts and late returns separately; one weekday morning departure does not prove the whole week works.
目的地二：旧金山西侧、Mission Bay 或离轨道较远的地点: Destination two: western SF, Mission Bay, or places away from rail
到旧金山市中心仍不一定到公司。给 Muni 换乘、过街、医院或园区内部步行留出位: Reaching downtown may leave a substantial journey to work. Include Muni transfers, crossings, and movement inside a hospital or campus, then compare a home on a direct city route. Caltrain's San Francisco terminal is around Fourth and King, not a universal downtown destination. For fixed shifts or family handoffs, test whether a later departure still works rather than using the fastest navigation result.
目的地三：半岛 Caltrain 沿线与园区: Destination three: the Peninsula rail corridor and office campuses
San Mateo、Redwood City、Palo Alto、Mountai: Around San Mateo, Redwood City, Palo Alto, and Mountain View, check the destination-to-station connection before the home-to-station walk. Verify the specific train's stops; an express may skip yours. If an employer shuttle is essential, confirm stops, eligibility, times, and after-hours arrangements with the employer. A shuttle line on a public map does not guarantee your access.
目的地四：南湾，先区分 BART、Caltrain 与 VTA: Destination four: distinguish South Bay BART, Caltrain, and VTA
Milpitas BART、Berryessa／North San José、S: Milpitas BART, Berryessa/North San José, San Jose Diridon, and Santa Clara are different stations. Berryessa may still require a bus or another connection. Downtown San Jose, Cupertino, and office campuses have different transport access. Use VTA's current system map to complete the final leg and check return service. Do not plan today's commute around future rail extensions.
目的地五与六：渡轮通勤和东湾内部行程: Destinations five and six: ferry commutes and trips within the East Bay
住处靠 Oakland、Main Street Alameda 或 Richmo: Near Oakland, Main Street Alameda, or Richmond terminals, compare SF Bay Ferry. Routes such as Harbor Bay and Alameda Seaplane have weekday service restrictions, so do not transfer one terminal's schedule to another. For Larkspur, Sausalito, and Tiburon, check Golden Gate Ferry. Include terminal access, waiting, and the destination-side walk, and decide separately how to return after an evening out.
如果主要在 Oakland、Berkeley、Fremont 或其他东湾地点活动: If most of your life is in Oakland, Berkeley, Fremont, or elsewhere in the East Bay, easy access to San Francisco may not be the deciding factor. Connect your two or three most frequent destinations: classes, groceries, pickups, or a regular activity may matter more than occasional SF trips. Measure convenience by the week you will actually live.
两次实测：一个正常工作日，一个容易出问题的回程: Two tests: a normal workday and a difficult return
第一次按预计上班时间出门，从锁门开始计时，到建筑入口结束；记步行、候车、换乘和车: On the first test, leave at the expected commute time and measure from locking the door to the building entrance, separating walking, waiting, transfers, and time aboard.
第二次选未来真实可能出现的晚归或周末时段，查最后可行连接；条件允许再实际体验。: For the second, use a late or weekend return you are likely to need. Check the last viable connection and try it in person when practical.
查下一班而不只查最理想的一班：错过一次会晚多久，是否影响打卡、接送或预约。: Check the following departure too: how much would missing one connection delay work, a pickup, or an appointment?
需要电梯、自行车、推车或轮椅时，核对当日设备状态、上下车空间和可通行路线。: If you need an elevator, bicycle, stroller, or wheelchair, check current equipment status, boarding space, and usable paths.
开车方案也从门到门计时：出车库、堵车、过桥、找停车与走到办公室都算；通行费和停车: Measure driving door to door too, including the garage exit, traffic, bridge, parking search, and final walk; record tolls and parking separately.
看房当天再走一圈：把生活资源画进半径: On viewing day, walk the everyday neighborhood too
从候选房门口走到食品店、药房、图书馆或日常要用的一处服务点，再找洗衣、包裹收取和: Walk from the candidate home to a grocery store, pharmacy, library, or another service you will use, then locate laundry, parcel collection, and transit stops. Check hours against your routine, whether heavy shopping needs a car, and where you would wait in rain. A daytime viewing does not show a late-return experience. Revisit the public route at a relevant time when practical, checking lighting, crossings, and sidewalks.
租金便宜多少才值得：把钱与时间分两列: How much cheaper makes it worthwhile: separate money and time
编辑演算示例，非市场租金或票价：甲方案比乙每月便宜 300 美元，但额外交通支出: Editorial example, not market rent or a fare quote: option A saves $300 in monthly rent but adds $120 in transport, leaving $180. An extra 30 minutes each way, four workdays per week over four weeks, adds 16 commute hours. Compare those hours with care duties, sleep, study, and your budget. One office day per week would change the calculation.
完整月支出还要列入水电网、停车、经常性的桥费、临时叫车和因距离增加的餐饮；押金、: Include utilities, parking, recurring tolls, backup car rides, and extra meal costs in the monthly total. Keep deposits, moving, and furniture in a separate one-time cash column. Confirm employer transit benefits and eligible fares before comparing passes; do not subtract an unconfirmed reimbursement.
